--- title: BirdNET model fitting subtitle: Bellbird mimicry author: Marcelo Araya-Salas date: "2026-11-19" toc: true toc-depth: 3 toc-location: left number-sections: true highlight-style: pygments format: html: df-print: kable code-fold: true code-tools: true css: qmd.css editor_options: chunk_output_type: console --- ::: {.cell} ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE) library(ggplot2) library(viridis) library(knitr) theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 14)) models <- c("sympatric_and_allopatric", "sympatric") model_labels <- c(sympatric_and_allopatric = "Sympatric + allopatric", sympatric = "Sympatric only") sympatric_spp <- c("Procnias tricarunculatus", "Psarocolius montezuma", "Pteroglossus torquatus", "Ramphastos sulfuratus") cli_dir <- "./data/processed/birdnet_models_cli" gui_dir <- "./data/processed/birdnet_models" class_dir <- "./data/processed/birdnet_classification_outputs_cli" ``` ::: # Purpose - Train the two custom BirdNET classifiers from code, instead of the BirdNET-Analyzer GUI, so the fitting is reproducible - Fix the random seed (123) so that re-running the script gives the same models - Evaluate the models on the held-out test clips and classify the focal bellbird clips - Choose the hyperparameters and classification thresholds by 5-fold cross-validation grouped by recording, and classify the focal bellbird clips with an ensemble of the cross-validated models ([Cross-validation](#cross-validation)) The two classifiers are: - **Sympatric + allopatric**: the three sympatric species the bellbird could have imitated (Keel-billed Toucan, Collared Aracari and Montezuma Oropendola), their closely related allopatric species (Yellow-throated Toucan, Pale-mandibled Aracari and Baudo Oropendola) and the Three-wattled Bellbird - **Sympatric only**: the three sympatric species and the Three-wattled Bellbird # Training and test data Clips were exported in [Data preparation](birdnet_acoustic_data_prep.qmd): an 80/20 split stratified by species, keeping all clips from a recording in the same set. Clips of other bellbirds in the test set were not used for training. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} count_clips <- function(split) { spp <- list.dirs(file.path("./data/processed/birdnet_data", split), recursive = FALSE, full.names = FALSE) setNames(sapply(spp, function(s) length(list.files(file.path("./data/processed/birdnet_data", split, s)))), spp) } train_n <- count_clips("train_data") test_n <- count_clips("test_data") clips <- data.frame(Species = names(train_n), Type = ifelse(names(train_n) %in% sympatric_spp, "Sympatric", "Allopatric"), Train = as.integer(train_n), Test = as.integer(test_n[names(train_n)])) clips$Type[clips$Species == "Procnias tricarunculatus"] <- "Bellbird" clips ``` ::: {.cell-output-display}
|Species |Type | Train| Test| |:--------------------------|:----------|-----:|----:| |Procnias tricarunculatus |Bellbird | 663| 137| |Psarocolius guatimozinus |Allopatric | 359| 51| |Psarocolius montezuma |Sympatric | 750| 65| |Pteroglossus erythropygius |Allopatric | 652| 214| |Pteroglossus torquatus |Sympatric | 409| 53| |Ramphastos brevis |Allopatric | 623| 185| |Ramphastos sulfuratus |Sympatric | 1040| 316|
::: ::: # Fitting This section and the next two use the original 80/20 train/test split, as in the GUI. These models were trained without a bandpass filter (0–15 kHz) and classified with a 400–12,000 Hz bandpass, as the GUI runs; the [cross-validation](#cross-validation) uses 400–12,000 Hz in both steps and supersedes them. Both models are trained with [`scripts/train_birdnet_models.sh`](https://github.com/maRce10/bellbird_vocal_mimicry/blob/master/scripts/train_birdnet_models.sh), which calls BirdNET-Analyzer (v2.4) through [`scripts/train_birdnet.py`](https://github.com/maRce10/bellbird_vocal_mimicry/blob/master/scripts/train_birdnet.py). That wrapper seeds Python, NumPy and TensorFlow (weights, shuffling, dropout, mixup), turns on deterministic TensorFlow operations and saves the training history. Training takes about a minute per model on a GPU. Re-running the training with the same seed gives the same evaluation and stops at the same epoch; per-epoch metrics differ only by floating-point rounding on the GPU (< 10-7). ::: {.cell} ```{.bash .cell-code code-fold="false"} # from the project root bash scripts/train_birdnet_models.sh train # fit both models (seed 123) bash scripts/train_birdnet_models.sh classify # classify test and focal bellbird clips ``` ::: ## Hyperparameters The same hyperparameters used in the GUI (read from the `_Params.csv` file each training run writes). Up to 50 epochs were allowed, with early stopping on the validation loss; the weights of the best epoch are kept. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} params <- do.call(rbind, lapply(models, function(m) { p <- read.csv(file.path(cli_dir, m, paste0(m, "_Params.csv")), check.names = FALSE) data.frame(Model = model_labels[[m]], p, check.names = FALSE) })) keep <- c("Model", "Hidden units", "Dropout", "Batchsize", "Learning rate", "Upsamling mode", "Upsamling ratio", "use mixup", "use focal loss", "focal loss alpha", "focal loss gamma") p <- params[, keep] names(p) <- c("Model", "Hidden units", "Dropout", "Batch size", "Learning rate", "Upsampling", "Upsampling ratio", "Mixup", "Focal loss", "Focal α", "Focal γ") p$`Focal α`[p$`Focal loss` == "False"] <- NA p$`Focal γ`[p$`Focal loss` == "False"] <- NA t(p) |> as.data.frame() |> setNames(p$Model) |> (\(x) x[-1, ])() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display}
| |Sympatric + allopatric |Sympatric only | |:----------------|:----------------------|:--------------| |Hidden units |2048 |256 | |Dropout |0.5 |0.5 | |Batch size |64 |16 | |Learning rate |0.001 |0.002 | |Upsampling |repeat |repeat | |Upsampling ratio |0.00 |0.33 | |Mixup |True |True | |Focal loss |True |False | |Focal α |0.75 |NA | |Focal γ |0.5 |NA |
::: ::: ## Training history The test clips are used as validation data, so the curves show performance on the held-out clips. The dashed line marks the epoch whose weights were kept (lowest validation loss). ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} hist <- do.call(rbind, lapply(models, function(m) { h <- read.csv(file.path(cli_dir, m, paste0(m, "_history.csv"))) data.frame(model = model_labels[[m]], epoch = rep(h$epoch, 4), metric = rep(c("Loss", "Loss", "AUPRC", "AUPRC"), each = nrow(h)), set = rep(c("Training", "Validation", "Training", "Validation"), each = nrow(h)), value = c(h$loss, h$val_loss, h$AUPRC, h$val_AUPRC)) })) hist$model <- factor(hist$model, levels = model_labels) best <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(hist[hist$metric == "Loss" & hist$set == "Validation", ], ~ model), function(d) d[which.min(d$value), c("model", "epoch")])) ggplot(hist, aes(epoch, value, color = set)) + geom_vline(data = best, aes(xintercept = epoch), linetype = 2, color = "grey50") + geom_line(linewidth = 1) + geom_point(size = 1.5) + facet_grid(metric ~ model, scales = "free") + scale_color_viridis_d(end = 0.7, name = "") + labs(x = "Epoch", y = "") + theme(legend.position = "top", strip.background = element_blank()) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](birdnet_model_fitting_files/figure-html/training history-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: # Model performance ## Evaluation on the test clips BirdNET's evaluation on the test clips. "Opt" columns use the optimal threshold for each species (the one that maximizes F1), which is the threshold used to accept a classification downstream. ```{.r .cell-code} read_eval <- function(dir, m) { e <- read.csv(file.path(dir, m, paste0(m, "_evaluation.csv")), check.names = FALSE) e[, c("Class", "Precision (opt)", "Recall (opt)", "F1 Score (opt)", "AUPRC", "AUROC", "Optimal Threshold", "Samples")] } for (m in models) { cat("\n\n###", model_labels[[m]], "\n\n") print(kable(read_eval(cli_dir, m), digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)) } ``` ### Sympatric + allopatric |Class | Precision confidence is assigned when it reaches its optimal threshold, otherwise the clip is left unassigned. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} read_tables <- function(path) { files <- list.files(path, pattern = "selection.table.txt$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE) tabs <- lapply(files, function(f) { x <- read.delim(f, check.names = FALSE) clip <- sub("\\.BirdNET\\.selection\\.table\\.txt$", "", basename(f)) if (nrow(x) == 0) return(data.frame(clip = clip, species = "nocall", confidence = NA)) data.frame(clip = clip, species = x$`Common Name`, confidence = x$Confidence) }) do.call(rbind, tabs) } # one classification per clip: best species above its optimal threshold, else unassigned assign_clip <- function(tab, m) { thr <- read_eval(cli_dir, m) thr <- setNames(thr$`Optimal Threshold`, thr$Class) tab$ok <- !is.na(tab$confidence) & tab$species %in% names(thr) & tab$confidence >= thr[tab$species] tab <- tab[order(tab$clip, !tab$ok, -tab$confidence), ] tab <- tab[!duplicated(tab$clip), ] tab$predicted <- ifelse(tab$ok, tab$species, "Unassigned") tab[, c("clip", "predicted", "confidence")] } test_class <- lapply(setNames(models, models), function(m) { x <- setNames(rep(s, test_n[[s]]), sub("\\.wav$", "", list.files(file.path("./data/processed/birdnet_data/test_data", s)))))) x$true <- truth[sub("\\.wav$", "", x$clip)] x <- x[!is.na(x$true), ] # keep test clips only if (m == "sympatric") x <- x[x$true %in% sympatric_spp, ] x }) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} conf <- do.call(rbind, lapply(models, function(m) { x <- test_class[[m]] tb <- as.data.frame(table(true = x$true, predicted = x$predicted)) tb$prop <- tb$Freq / ave(tb$Freq, tb$true, FUN = sum) tb$model <- model_labels[[m]] tb })) conf$model <- factor(conf$model, levels = ::: ::: # Focal bellbird classification Classification of the 1660 focal bellbird clips with the models trained here, compared with the classification obtained with the GUI models (as used in the [statistical analysis](statistical_analysis.qmd)). ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} gui_class_dirs <- c(sympatric_and_allopatric = "./data/processed/birdnet_classification_outputs/mimic_bellbird/sympatrics_and_allopatrics_model", sympatric = "./data/processed/birdnet_classification_outputs/mimic_bellbird/sympatric_model") focal <- do.call(rbind, lapply(models, function(m) { code <- assign_clip(read_tables(file.path(class_dir, "mimic_bellbird", m)), m) gui <- read_tables(gui_class_dirs[[m]]) gui_thr <- read_eval(gui_dir, m) gui_thr <- setNames(gui_thr$`Optimal Threshold`, gui_thr$Class) gui$ok <- !is.na(gui$confidence) & gui$species %in% names(gui_thr) & gui$confidence >= gui_thr[gui$species] gui <- gui[order(gui$clip, !gui$ok, -gui$confidence), ] gui <- gui[!duplicated(gui$clip), ] gui$predicted <- ifelse(gui$ok, gui$species, "Unassigned") rbind(data.frame(model = model_labels[[m]], fitting = "Code (seed 123)", predicted = code$predicted), data.frame(model = model_labels[[m]], fitting = "GUI", predicted = gui$predicted)) })) focal_tab <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(paste(focal$model, "|", focal$predicted), focal$fitting)) focal_tab <- cbind(Model = sub(" \\|.*", "", rownames(focal_tab)), `Classified as` = sub(".*\\| ", "", rownames(focal_tab)), focal_tab) rownames(focal_tab) <- NULL focal_tab ``` ::: {.cell-output-display}

::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} fp <- as.data.frame(table(model = focal$model, fitting = focal$fitting, predicted = focal$predicted)) fp <- fp[fp$Freq > 0, ] fp$model <- factor(fp$model, levels = model_labels) fp$predicted <- short(as.character(fp$predicted)) ggplot(fp, aes(predicted, Freq, fill = fitting)) + geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.75) + geom_text(aes(label = Freq), position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), vjust = -0.3, size = 3.5) + facet_wrap(~ model, scales = "free_x") + scale_fill_viridis_d(begin = 0.3, end = 0.8, name = "") + labs(x = "", y = "Focal bellbird clips") + theme(legend.position = "top", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "italic"), strip.background = element_blank()) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](birdnet_model_fitting_files/figure-html/focal plot-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: # Cross-validation {#cross-validation} BirdNET validates on a single holdout: the test clips are used to stop training, to choose the per-species thresholds and to report performance. To get estimates that do not depend on one split, and thresholds not tuned on the clips used to score them, the models were cross-validated with [`scripts/birdnet_cv.sh`](https://github.com/maRce10/bellbird_vocal_mimicry/blob/master/scripts/birdnet_cv.sh). ## Design - All train and test clips were pooled and split into 5 folds with a stratified group k-fold (seed 123): all clips of a recording fall in the same fold, and the folds are balanced by species. Five folds keep about 3 recordings of the species with fewest recordings (*P. guatimozinus*, 15) in each fold - For each fold, the models were trained on the other 4 folds and classified the held-out fold, so every clip has one out-of-fold prediction from a model that never saw its recording - Training stops early on a random 20% of the training clips (the held-out fold is not used for training in any way). Training and classification use a 400–12,000 Hz bandpass; seed 123 - Three hyperparameter configurations were compared for each model: - **A**: the settings of the GUI sympatric + allopatric model (2,048 hidden units, focal loss, mixup) - **B**: the settings of the GUI sympatric-only model (256 hidden units, upsampling, mixup) - **C**: BirdNET defaults (linear classifier, no dropout, mixup, upsampling or focal loss) - The selection rule was set before looking at the results: the configuration with the highest macro-averaged AUPRC on the out-of-fold predictions (threshold-free), judged separately for each model - Per-species thresholds are the ones that maximize F1 on the out-of-fold predictions; a clip is assigned to the species with the highest confidence if it reaches that species' threshold, otherwise it is left unassigned ::: {.cell} ```{.bash .cell-code code-fold="false"} bash scripts/birdnet_cv.sh all # folds, 30 trainings (3 configurations x 2 models x 5 folds) and classifications ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} source("scripts/birdnet_cv_functions.R") folds <- read.csv(file.path(cv_dir, "folds.csv")) configs <- c("A", "B", "C") cv_res <- list() for (cf in configs) for (m in models) { sc <- oof_scores(cf, m, folds) spp <- model_spp[[m]] thr <- optimal_thresholds(sc, spp) cv_res[[cf]][[m]] <- list(scores = sc, thr = thr, metrics = cv_metrics(sc, spp, thr), folds = fold_metrics(sc, spp, thr)) } ``` ::: ## Folds ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ft <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(folds$species, folds$fold)) names(ft) <- paste("Fold", names(ft)) rec <- tapply(paste(folds$species, folds$recording), folds$fold, function(x) length(unique(x))) rbind(ft, Recordings = as.integer(rec), `Total clips` = colSums(ft)) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display}

::: ::: ## Comparison of configurations Out-of-fold macro-averaged AUPRC and F1 (thresholds from the out-of-fold predictions). Error bars: standard deviation across folds. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} cmp_cv <- do.call(rbind, lapply(configs, function(cf) do.call(rbind, lapply(models, function(m) { r <- cv_res[[cf]][[m]] data.frame(Model = model_labels[[m]], Configuration = cf, AUPRC = r$metrics$macro[["AUPRC"]], `AUPRC SD` = sd(r$folds$AUPRC), F1 = r$metrics$macro[["F1"]], `F1 SD` = sd(r$folds$F1), Accuracy = r$metrics$macro[["accuracy"]], check.names = FALSE) })))) cmp_cv$Model <- factor(cmp_cv$Model, levels = model_labels) best_cfg <- sapply(models, function(m) { d <- cmp_cv[cmp_cv$Model == model_labels[[m]], ] d$Configuration[order(-d$AUPRC, -d$F1)[1]] }) cmp_cv$Selected <- ifelse(cmp_cv$Configuration == best_cfg[match(cmp_cv$Model, model_labels)], "✓", "") long <- rbind(data.frame(cmp_cv[, c("Model", "Configuration")], metric = "Macro AUPRC", value = cmp_cv$AUPRC, sd = cmp_cv$`AUPRC SD`), data.frame(cmp_cv[, c("Model", "Configuration")], metric = "Macro F1", value = cmp_cv$F1, sd = cmp_cv$`F1 SD`)) ggplot(long, aes(Configuration, value, color = Configuration)) + geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = value - sd, ymax = value + sd), size = 0.6, linewidth = 1) + facet_grid(metric ~ Model, scales = "free_y") + scale_color_viridis_d(end = 0.8, guide = "none") + labs(x = "Configuration", y = "") + theme(strip.background = element_blank()) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](birdnet_model_fitting_files/figure-html/cv comparison-1.png){width=960} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} kable(cmp_cv[order(cmp_cv$Model), ], digits = 3, row.names = FALSE) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} |Model |Configuration | AUPRC| AUPRC SD| F1| F1 SD| Accuracy|Selected | |:----------------------|:-------------|-----:|--------:|-----:|-----:|--------:|:--------| |Sympatric + allopatric |A | 0.881| 0.045| 0.822| 0.047| 0.822|✓ | |Sympatric + allopatric |B | 0.875| 0.038| 0.805| 0.041| 0.807| | |Sympatric + allopatric |C | 0.853| 0.035| 0.799| 0.035| 0.804| | |Sympatric only |A | 0.987| 0.003| 0.939| 0.021| 0.907| | |Sympatric only |B | 0.986| 0.005| 0.930| 0.015| 0.901| | |Sympatric only |C | 0.991| 0.007| 0.947| 0.021| 0.920|✓ | ::: ::: Selected configurations: **A** for the sympatric + allopatric model and **C** for the sympatric-only model. ::: ::: ## Focal bellbird classification (ensemble) The focal bellbird clips are classified with the 5 fold models of the selected configuration (A for sympatric + allopatric, C for sympatric only): the confidence of each species is averaged across the 5 models and the out-of-fold thresholds are applied. The predictions are saved in `data/processed/birdnet_cv/focal_predictions_.csv`. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} focal_cv <- do.call(rbind, lapply(models, function(m) { cf <- best_cfg[[m]] en <- ensemble_scores(cf, m) en$predicted <- assign_species(en, model_spp[[m]], cv_res[[cf]][[m]]$thr) write.csv(en, file.path(cv_dir, paste0("focal_predictions_", m, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE) data.frame(model = model_labels[[m]], fitting = "Cross-validated ensemble", predicted = en$predicted) })) # out-of-fold predictions of the training clips, for downstream use for (m in models) { r <- cv_res[[best_cfg[[m]]]][[m]] write.csv(data.frame(r$scores, predicted = r$metrics$pred, check.names = FALSE), file.path(cv_dir, paste0("oof_predictions_", m, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE) } fc <- rbind(focal_cv, focal[focal$fitting == "GUI", ]) fc_tab <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(paste(fc$model, "|", fc$predicted), fc$fitting)) fc_tab <- cbind(Model = sub(" \\|.*", "", rownames(fc_tab)), `Classified as` = sub(".*\\| ", "", rownames(fc_tab)), fc_tab) rownames(fc_tab) <- NULL fc_tab ``` ::: {.cell-output-display}

Thresholds tuned on these clips move a lot between fits - 5-fold cross-validation grouped by recording selected configuration A for the sympatric + allopatric model (out-of-fold macro AUPRC 0.881) and C for the sympatric-only model (0.991); differences between configurations are within fold-to-fold variation - The weakest classes are the aracaris and the oropendolas in the sympatric + allopatric model, where each is confused with its close relative (*P. torquatus* with *P. erythropygius* above all);
